items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: I just know about Udell. He made piano rolls.

ctx.x: He couldn't read a note as big as a boxcar. No. But man, he played anything he'd hear. Anything. Don't care what it was. He played. And that's where I saw Steve. I had the, when I was little we had, I used to live around where they had these what you would call hunky-tongs. And they had the one on Orleans near Liberty that they called the Blues Breakers. And I had the pleasure of listening to a fellow by the name of Udell playing. Who used to make, I don't know, I just know about Udell. He made piano rolls. The…
